title: whk 1.20.2
items: The changelog lists whk 1.20.2: exit statuses that follow the documented table, quiet exits when a pipe closes, plain output without a terminal, and clearer errors
The CLI pages describe the `exit` field on failures, `whk share --json`'s `error` event, colour without a terminal, and where `whk replay --to` sends a request
The Share localhost page says that a new share under one of your own names replaces your older one
